Subject: Commercial Bank RFI: Operational Continuity & Audit Evidence

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the intro — CommercialBank is preparing a vendor review for our commercial lending platform and we need detailed responses to our operational continuity and audit evidence questions. The control areas of highest priority for our regulator are: business continuity testing cadence, disaster recovery (DR) RTO/RPO, incident detection and escalation workflows, access and privileged account logging, and retention of audit logs for at least 7 years.

Attached is the bank's RFI template (we've prefilled high-level items). Please confirm whether you can provide:
- A table mapping Redwood controls to our FFIEC-style control IDs (we're using our spreadsheet columns AC-01 through AC-18).
- Representative evidence: last three DR test reports, SOC2 summary, on-call runbook, and sample audit logs (anonymized).
- Any planned changes to infrastructure or retention policies in the next 12 months.

Can you get a first-pass response and evidence package by July 14? If not, propose a date and we can arrange a short call.

Thanks,
Lisa Kent
Vendor Risk & Third-Party Oversight
CommercialBank PLC

Attachments: CommercialBank_RFI_Template.xlsx (spreadsheet, 156 KB)

Lisa — thanks for sending this and for the clear priorities. We're able to respond and assemble the evidence you requested. A couple quick clarifying points before we map controls:

1) For the mapping, do you require column-level proofs (e.g., log export samples per control) or is a control-to-evidence reference sufficient (e.g., AC-04 -> SOC2 section 3.2 + sample anonymized log)?
2) When you say "last three DR test reports", do you mean live failover exercises or tabletop/resilience runbooks? We can provide both but the live failover reports include operational details that may need redaction.

Tentative timeline from our side:
- Jul 7: Control mapping (draft)
- Jul 9: Evidence package stub (SOC2 summary, runbook, redacted logs)
- Jul 14: Finalized spreadsheet and attachments for your intake team

I'm copying Marissa as the account lead and Ben for security / audit evidence. Naomi can also help coordinate the runbook redaction if needed — looping her in if that's OK.

Best,
Evelyn Hart

- We map your AC-01..AC-18 controls to Redwood artifacts (SOC2 sections, platform runbook sections, and our retention policy).

Deliverables and dates we propose:

Lisa — attaching the security artifacts per Marissa's timeline. Quick notes up front:

- SOC2: We are including the SOC2 Summary (redwood_soc2-summary.pdf). This provides control narratives for logical access, change management, and incident response. Full SOC2 report is available under NDA; let us know if you need that for procurement.
- DR tests: Two redacted failover reports attached. We redact private host identifiers; timestamps and milestone durations remain intact so you can validate RTO/RPO claims.
- Audit logging: sample_logs_2026-03.csv contains pseudonymized request IDs and event types. The raw ingestion pipeline uses an immutable append-only ledger with signed offsets; if Grant Thornton needs a hash-chain verification we can provide that under a limited access arrangement.
- Retention & legal hold: Our default retention policy meets 7-year retention via cold archive; in the event of a litigation hold we snapshot the relevant range to a separate WORM bucket for the duration of the hold.

Attachments (in this message): redwood_soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 84 KB); runbook_excerpt_2026.txt (txt, 18 KB); DR_failover_2025-11_redacted.pdf (pdf, 312 KB); DR_failover_2026-03_redacted.pdf (pdf, 288 KB); sample_logs_2026-03.csv (csv, 64 KB).
